source: maplestory.io (GMS 270) — skillbook API + raw WZ API
notes: Beginner book job 6002 was pulled via the raw WZ API: the skillbook API fails it on every attempt (WZProperty cast error), like jobs 6000/6001/10000.

Angelic Buster's 5th-job set is the 4 class-specific actives (Sparkle Burst, Superstar Spotlight, Mighty Mascot, Trinity Fusion) plus shared Pirate V (Loaded Dice, Roll of the Dice, Overdrive); all-class common V skills plus Might of the Nova are out of scope as in every other completed class.
HEXA book 6514 is complete at 13 skills incl. Origin Grand Finale and Surprise Encore; Encore Ribbon 65140007 is also in the book.
Beginner book 6002 has 3 invisible no-name skills with frames, listed as skill-<id>.
HEXA Boost note: Chain Arts: Thrash Boost (400004731) matches a Beginner skill shared with Cadena's book; boost cores are per-skill, so it appears in both classes.
Ball frames are projectile sprites preserved as 'ball' arrays.
WZ fallback repair: a second-pass layer-key bug misfiled a few retried frames under numeric keys (found in 6 skills across the branch, fixed and re-extracted).
